lines.speaker: Panicked Villager
lines.text: They'll kill them Frieda! Please, don't go near the soldiers!

lines.speaker: Frieda
lines.text: I can't stay hidden while others die.

lines.speaker: Frieda
lines.text: So be it! Maybe, just maybe, they'll listen if someone steps forward unarmed.

lines.speaker: Ezra
lines.text: This seems to be during a riot... when she stopped innocent women from being executed.

lines.speaker: Ezra
lines.text: She stepped in without hesitation. That kind of bravery isn't common.

lines.speaker: Ezra
lines.text: I need to understand who she really was.
